source: Technology Promotion Project to Increase Productivity Around Tonle Sap (TSTD — TA 7305-CAM), watermelon (ដំណាំឪឡឹក) technical training booklet, prepared by the project's agricultural techniques and extension officer in cooperation with East West Seed International, November 2016. Contact: livleanghy@gmail.com
text:
Watermelon can typically be harvested starting at about 50 to 60 days of age, depending on the variety planted.

Care should be taken not to damage the vine/stem when harvesting so fruit quality is preserved. Use a knife to cut the fruit stem rather than pulling or twisting the fruit off the vine, since yanking the fruit can damage both the fruit and the remaining plant.

Handle harvested fruit carefully to avoid bruising or cracking, and avoid dropping or throwing fruit during collection and transport.
